correct.zh: 保密协议（NDA，保密义务合同）是这样一种合同：约定对方不得把交易过程中向其披露的信息用于目的之外的用途，也不得泄露给第三方。本题中，N公司为了让B公司和C公司编制报价单，必须向它们提供本公司的信息，例如待开发系统的需求或规格等。在报价委托这个阶段，对方还不是承接方，而且处于多家公司相互竞争的状态，因此交出去的信息存在经由其中某一方流出到公司外部的风险。为了防止这一点，才在发出报价委托的同时与两家公司签订保密协议。因此，选项エ「为了防止为编制报价单而提供给B公司、C公司的信息，经由其中任何一方泄露到外部」是正确答案。
correct.en: A confidentiality agreement (NDA, non-disclosure agreement) is a contract in which the other party promises not to use the information disclosed to it during a transaction for purposes other than the intended one, and not to leak it to third parties. In this question, in order to have Company B and Company C prepare quotations, Company N must hand over its own information, such as the requirements and specifications of the system to be developed. At the quotation-request stage the other parties are not yet the contractors, and several companies are competing with each other, so there is a risk that the information handed over will leak outside the company through one of them. To prevent this, Company N concludes confidentiality agreements with both companies at the same time as it requests the quotations. Therefore choice エ, “To prevent the information given to Company B and Company C for preparing the quotations from leaking outside through either of them”, is the correct answer.

distractors.zh: 禁止再委托（转包给下游承接方）是在业务委托合同或承揽合同中规定的条款，并不是以信息保密为目的的保密协议所承担的作用。而且本题还处在报价委托阶段，尚未与外部采购方签订业务委托合同，因此选项ア所预设的「与N公司签约的业务」还不存在，从这一点来看也不成立。
distractors.en: Prohibiting subcontracting (re-entrusting the work to a lower-tier supplier) is a clause set out in a service outsourcing contract or a contract for work; it is not the role of a confidentiality agreement, whose purpose is to keep information secret. Moreover, this question is still at the quotation-request stage, before any outsourcing contract has been signed with an external supplier, so “the work contracted with Company N” that choice ア presupposes does not yet exist — another reason why it does not apply.

distractors.zh: 由发包方直接对外部采购方的员工发出指挥命令，在承揽合同下是不被允许的，只有在劳务派遣合同的情况下才被允许（未经相应约定就这样做，就构成伪装承揽）。无论如何，规定指挥命令关系的都不是保密协议，因此把它作为签订理由并不恰当。
distractors.en: Having the client give instructions and orders directly to the employees of an external supplier is not permitted under a contract for work; it is permitted only under a worker dispatch (staffing) contract, and doing it without such an arrangement amounts to disguised contracting. In any case, it is not a confidentiality agreement that defines the chain of command, so this is not an appropriate reason for concluding one.

distractors.zh: 著作权是在作品被创作出来的时点自动产生的权利，即使不签订合同，法律也会予以保护。如果希望明确软件著作权的归属，应在业务委托合同等合同中约定权利归属条款。保密协议保护的是「已披露的秘密信息」，而不是著作权本身。
distractors.en: Copyright is a right that arises automatically at the moment a work is created, and it is protected by law even without any contract. If you want to make the ownership of the copyright in software clear, you set out an ownership-of-rights clause in a contract such as a service outsourcing contract. What a confidentiality agreement protects is “the confidential information that has been disclosed”, not the copyright itself.

points.zh: 保密协议（NDA，保密义务合同）＝为了让对方不把交易过程中向其披露的信息用于目的之外的用途、也不泄露给第三方而签订的合同。即使在正式接单之前的报价委托或提案邀请（RFP）阶段，只要要交出本公司的信息，原则上也要签订；向多家公司发出委托时，要与每一家分别签订。
points.en: A confidentiality agreement (NDA) = a contract concluded so that the other party will neither use the information disclosed to it during a transaction for purposes outside the intended one nor leak it to third parties. Even at the pre-award stage of a quotation request or a request for proposal (RFP), as long as you hand over your own company's information you should conclude one as a matter of principle, and when you approach several companies you conclude one with each of them.

points.zh: 要把合同的种类和它所保护的对象对应起来记忆。能否再委托、交付物的著作权归属，属于业务委托合同（承揽合同）的条款；指挥命令关系是劳务派遣合同的考点；而保密协议保护的是信息的机密性。
points.en: Remember which type of contract protects what. Whether subcontracting is allowed and who owns the copyright in the deliverables are clauses of a service outsourcing contract (contract for work); the chain of command is an issue of a worker dispatch contract; and what a confidentiality agreement protects is the confidentiality of information.
